title: The Twelfth Doctor — Borrowed Time
summary: Cast lose-the-game spells from anywhere but hand so the Twelfth Doctor demonstrates copies to opponents, then end your own turn before the bill arrives.

tags.name: spell copy
tags.reason: The Twelfth Doctor's demonstrate is the whole engine, backed by Hive Mind, Jace Reawakened, and Founding the Third Path.

tags.name: extra turns
tags.reason: Final Fortune, Last Chance, Warrior's Oath, and Alchemist's Gambit are the payload; copied versions hand opponents fatal turns.

tags.name: impulse draw
tags.reason: Prosper, Hidetsugu, Sanar, Jeleva, and the discover caves exile cards to cast from exile and trigger demonstrate.

tags.name: alternate wincon
tags.reason: Opponents lose to their own copied pact and extra-turn triggers rather than to damage.

tags.name: spellslinger
tags.reason: Instant- and sorcery-dense list with Kess, Johann, Emet-Selch, and Sphinx of Forgotten Lore recasting them.

tags.name: topdeck
tags.reason: Scroll Rack, Fblthp, The Reality Chip, Johann, and Scheming Symmetry manage the library top for cast-from-top turns.

tags.name: counterspells
tags.reason: Flusterstorm, Double Negative, Pact of Negation, Reverse the Polarity, and Spider-Sense protect the combo turn.

tags.name: foretell
tags.reason: Dream Devourer and Bohn grant every card foretell, the cheapest way to cast from exile every turn.

tags.name: graveyard
tags.reason: Kess, Vohar, Emet-Selch, and Sphinx of Forgotten Lore recast instants and sorceries from the graveyard.

tags.name: chaos
tags.reason: Hive Mind, Ensnared by the Mara, Prisoner's Dilemma, and Mob Verdict make the table play your game.

tags.name: theft
tags.reason: Jeleva, Intellect Devourer, Dauthi Voidwalker, Synthesis Pod, and Sudden Substitution play with everyone else's cards.

tags.name: politics
tags.reason: Demonstrate picks a beneficiary each copy, and Vislor Turlough plus Bohn goad problem creatures.

tags.name: self-discard
tags.reason: Rona, Vohar, Conspiracy Theorist, and One with Nothing dump the hand so the graveyard becomes the real hand.

tags.name: time lords
tags.reason: The Twelfth Doctor is the only Time Lord, but Trenzalore Clocktower is here for him.
